content: cron-job.org is a free, no-credit-card scheduled HTTP request service with per-request history/logs, commonly used to ping a /health endpoint every 5-10 min to prevent Render free-tier spin-down. More reliable timing than GitHub Actions scheduled workflows (which have no delay SLA and a 5-min floor); GitHub Actions cron is free but best-effort/delayed, so a dedicated pinger (cron-job.org) is preferred for the keep-alive role specifically, while GitHub Actions can still be used for the poll-trigger endpoint call if simplicity (no third-party account) is preferred over reliability.
